record.title: Elevated network errors for traffic routed between North America origins and SIN (Singapore) colo

updates.body:
Between 23rd August 2026, 01:06 UTC - 01:54 UTC, some customers may have experienced elevated 5xx errors and timeouts for traffic between North American origins and our Singapore data centre.

This issue is now resolved.
